projects.name: Remote Museum Visiting Platform with Telepresence Robot
projects.description: This was a real-world collaborative project developed with the Australian Museum and the R&D department of Sage Labs, an internationally operating company specialising in social robotics. The project explored how a new telepresence robot could support remote museum visits, allowing users to navigate a physical exhibition space online while maintaining clarity, orientation, and a sense of intentional exploration.

details.challenge: A familiar idea, seen from a different angle. The brief was to create a distinct visual language that feels clear, intentional, and a little unexpected.
details.approach: We began with research, sketches, and a simple question: what can we remove? Through typography, material studies, and digital experiments, the direction became a cohesive system.
details.outcome: A flexible identity with room to grow. From the smallest detail to the complete experience, every element shares the same visual rhythm.
